series_name: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
synopsis: The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?
